commands.enchant.remove.success.single: Removed enchantment %s from the item held by %s.
enchantment.galosphere.enfeeble.desc: Saltbound tablet pillars briefly slow targets they hit.
enchantment.galosphere.rupture.desc: Saltbound tablet pillars burst into flying pink salt shards when they expire. Higher levels release more shards.
enchantment.galosphere.sifting.desc: Gives a chance to brush a suspicious block a second time for more loot. Higher levels increase the chance.
enchantment.galosphere.sustain.desc: Makes saltbound tablet pillars remain active for longer.
enchantment.nova_structures.antidote.des: Protects against direct magic damage, including poison. Poison is not removed and still wears out the chestplate.
enchantment.nova_structures.boss_behavio: Internal structure encounter enchantment for boss attacks. This is not a normal player enchantment.
enchantment.nova_structures.conductivity: May attract lightning to the wearer during thunderstorms when exposed to the sky.
enchantment.nova_structures.ghasted.desc: Makes crossbow arrows ignite and explode on impact, but increases charging time. Higher levels strengthen these effects.
enchantment.nova_structures.gravity.desc: Crossbow arrows create an inward blast on impact, pulling nearby entities toward the impact.
enchantment.nova_structures.illagers_ban: Increases damage against entities in the illager group.
enchantment.nova_structures.multishot.de: Makes a bow fire additional arrows with a wider spread.
enchantment.nova_structures.outreach.des: Increases block interaction reach while the enchanted chestplate is worn. Higher levels extend it further.
enchantment.nova_structures.photosynthes: Slowly repairs the item during clear daytime when its user is exposed to the sky.
enchantment.nova_structures.piercing.des: Makes bow arrows pierce through additional entities. Higher levels increase the number of targets.
enchantment.nova_structures.power.desc: Increases arrow damage when the enchanted crossbow is held in the main hand.
enchantment.nova_structures.shulker_boss: Internal enchantment for a structure shulker boss. It is not ordinary player loot.
enchantment.nova_structures.shulker_mini: Internal enchantment for a structure shulker miniboss. It is not ordinary player loot.
enchantment.nova_structures.traveler.des: Improves running speed and step height while sprinting on land, with occasional durability wear.
enchantment.nova_structures.wax_wings.de: Cancels ordinary elytra durability wear, but fast flight can damage the wings, with extra wear high above the ground in clear daylight.
enchantment.nova_structures.wither_coate: Melee attacks inflict Wither, but the weapon takes additional durability damage.
effect.fungidelight.burrowing.descriptio: Increases mining speed for blocks normally mined with a shovel. Higher levels increase the bonus.
effect.fungidelight.weak_stomach.descrip: Drinking non-water potions or alcohol, or eating certain foods, causes nausea, poison and weakness while this effect is active.
effect.galosphere.astral.description: Allows passage through most solid blocks, changes vision and prevents suffocation inside blocks. Some blocks remain impassable.
effect.galosphere.halite_curse.descripti: Immobilizes the affected entity and marks it as afflicted by the halite curse.
effect.quark.resilience.description: Increases knockback resistance. Higher levels provide more resistance.
effect.xaerominimap.no_minimap.descripti: Temporarily disables the minimap. This is a map-restriction effect, not a normal potion.
effect.xaerominimap.no_minimap_harmful.d: Temporarily disables the minimap. This is a map-restriction effect, not a normal potion.
effect.xaerominimap.no_entity_radar.desc: Temporarily disables the minimap entity radar. This does not enable radar that is disabled by pack settings.
effect.xaerominimap.no_entity_radar_harm: Temporarily disables the minimap entity radar. This does not enable radar that is disabled by pack settings.
effect.xaerominimap.no_waypoints.descrip: Temporarily hides minimap waypoints. This is a map-restriction effect, not a normal potion.
effect.xaerominimap.no_waypoints_harmful: Temporarily hides minimap waypoints. This is a map-restriction effect, not a normal potion.
effect.xaerominimap.no_cave_maps.descrip: Temporarily disables underground minimap views. This is a map-restriction effect, not a normal potion.
effect.xaerominimap.no_cave_maps_harmful: Temporarily disables underground minimap views. This is a map-restriction effect, not a normal potion.
effect.xaeroworldmap.no_world_map.descri: Temporarily disables the world map. This is a map-restriction effect, not a normal potion.
effect.xaeroworldmap.no_world_map_harmfu: Temporarily disables the world map. This is a map-restriction effect, not a normal potion.
effect.xaeroworldmap.no_cave_maps.descri: Temporarily disables underground world-map views. This is a map-restriction effect, not a normal potion.
effect.xaeroworldmap.no_cave_maps_harmfu: Temporarily disables underground world-map views. This is a map-restriction effect, not a normal potion.
